entry.title: Anthropic is letting METR researchers look under the hood with employee-level access
entry.summary: METR will publish its own assessments of Anthropic’s risks, incidents, and practices, and the frontier AI model maker has given up the right to block them.

entry.title: Bluesky wants to make it easier to buy, sell, and fundraise on the network
entry.summary: The executives argued that advertising isn’t the only path to monetization, and that there are alternative models that are feasible when it comes to monetization.

entry.title: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay sees a future where AI devices replace the need to use apps
entry.summary: Speaking at TechCrunch Disrupt, Amazon devices chief Panos Panay described a future where ambient AI devices work in the background, anticipating users' needs instead of waiting for commands.

entry.title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
entry.summary: Meta and Apple have teamed up for the launch of the social media giant's newest model, Muse Spark Open, which will run locally on Apple silicon.

entry.title: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay on the importance of failure and bouncing back from it
entry.summary: Panay said that it's possible to recover and learn from all sorts of failures, even catastrophic ones, when building products.

entry.title: And the winner of Startup Battlefield at Disrupt 2026 is: Intero Biosystems
entry.summary: Intero Biosystems beat out 199 other Startup Battlefield companies to take home the $100,000 grand prize at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026.

entry.title: When it came to Cal AI’s viral success, a small army of influencers paid off
entry.summary: The company generated over $30 million in revenue in two years and was acquired by MyFitnessPal for an undisclosed amount of money in March.

entry.title: Tesla reveals SpaceX-powered Roadster that flies and falls with style
entry.summary: The new car used thrusters to leap over a Cybercab, Cybertruck, Tesla Semi, Model Y, and Model 3 at a demo in Texas.

entry.title: Even Benchmark thinks AI is eroding the venture pact against backing rivals
entry.summary: Benchmark says the Valley’s rule against backing rivals is getting harder to keep.

entry.title: Replit’s CEO says the future of work is the ‘self-driving company’
entry.summary: Replit CEO Amjad Masad envisions a future of “self-driving companies,” where AI agents handle day-to-day tasks and people focus on higher-level decisions.

entry.title: Veritas expands its anti-counterfeit chip to jewelry, trophies, and fragrance bottles
entry.summary: Counterfeiters are getting better at replicating brands' marks and passing off dupes, known as "superfakes," as genuine items. A startup called Veritas wants to tackle the problem with its own chip that verifies goods.

entry.title: Mark Wahlberg on using AI in film ‘the right way’ and being open to an AI clone carrying on his legacy
entry.summary: Actor and angel investor Mark Wahlberg says he's OK with using AI in filmmaking, provided it's used "to enhance what you're doing."

entry.title: Jev is Vercel’s fastest-adopted AI model ever
entry.summary: The data comes from Vercel's AI gateway, a unified API service similar to OpenRouter.

entry.title: In ‘You Can See Everything,’ Elizabeth Holmes meets her equal in comedian Nathan Fielder
entry.summary: Nathan Fielder's documentary about disgraced Theranos CEO Elizabeth Holmes has created a constellation of colliding personas that interrogate the very nature of authenticity.

entry.title: Tressfecta wants to make hair braiding a less arduous task for hairstylists
entry.summary: Tressfecta builds products for textured hair. Its first project is a tool called Plait Pilot that helps braiders with the initial process of separating hair from packs before braiding begins.

entry.title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
entry.summary: According to Elorian's evaluations, Glimpse outperforms even GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.

entry.title: Waymo’s robotaxis are headed to Canada
entry.summary: The company will start off by testing its self-driving vehicles on Toronto's streets.

entry.summary: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA’s robotics platforms, says robotics is currently in its “Lego era,” with the basic building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards still being rebuilt.  This view runs counter to those who believe that robotics, powered by a general foundation model, is about to have […]

entry.title: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
entry.summary: The agents got in through credentials and connection settings left exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.
